Poly Haven 2K ground materials

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
Source: https://polyhaven.com/textures

Assets used:
- sparse_grass
- dirt
- forest_floor
- forrest_ground_03
- mud_forest
- stony_dirt_path
- grass_path_3
- snow_02

Diffuse and OpenGL normal maps are used at 2048x2048 with mipmaps and GPU
compression. The original authors and per-asset metadata are available on each
asset page and through https://api.polyhaven.com/files/{asset_id}.
